content.text:
The chat now re-renders on every streamed chunk instead of in batches. I haven't run the app to watch it happen.

**Cause:** `useAgentChat` (from `agents/chat/react`) groups state updates into 50ms windows by default. So when chunks arrived quickly, several of them shared one re-render, and the TokenMeter undercounted.

**Fix:** in `src/client/Chat.jsx:8` I passed `throttle: false`. The library's type definitions say that setting means "render every chunk as it arrives." It also correctly handles both spellings of the option that `@ai-sdk/react` uses across its versions.

One caveat: React can still merge updates that happen in the same browser task. I expect that's fine here, because each WebSocket message is handled as its own task.
